Halcyan 2 wrote:
>
> Have I missed a ruling, or can Majesty only be played at close-range? I just
> checked the various Errata/Rulings/Clarifications section and found nothing for
> Majesty. Since Majesty more or less just says "Strike: Combat Ends," and the
> rules state that strike's only apply at close range UNLESS explicitly stated,
> then Majesty can't be used at long range. In this case, it's not half as bad
> to counter against. So did I miss a ruling, or restate the obvious?
>
> Halcyan 2

Rulebook:

"Most strikes are effective only at close range. Unless the strike is
identified as ranged or does 'R' damage (or is a defensive strike like
Dodge or Combat Ends), it is only effective at close range." [6.4.3.2]

"Combat Ends is effective at any range." [6.4.5]
